description.value: Île Sauvage Brewing is a craft brewery in Victoria specializing in Belgian-style wild ales and sour beers, with a tasting room on Bridge Street. The name translates to 'Wild Island,' referencing both Vancouver Island's wilderness and the brewery's focus on Kveik, Lactobacillus, and Brettanomyces fermentations, oak-ageing, and local fruit refermentations. Cyclists stopping in will find a rotating selection of wild and sour beers available on tap and for takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms an operational craft brewery with a tasting room at 2960 Bridge St, Victoria, BC. The About page confirms specialization in Belgian-style wild ales and sour beers. The store page confirms pick-up orders via Square and delivery via SkipTheDishes, establishing takeout as true. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, no address, no phone, and empty osm_tags — appears to be a manually added stub record with minimal OSM data.
Website uses stylized capitalization 'îLE SAUVAGE BREWING' which differs from OSM name 'Île Sauvage Brewing'; treated as stylization only, not a substantive discrepancy.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational craft brewery with a confirmed tasting room in Victoria on the Vancouver Crossing Loop route. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking local beer and takeout.
